text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan

(Lebuh Raya Pantai Timur–Fasa 2) 2015.

 (2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 29 Januari 2015.

Perisytiharan jalan sebagai jalan Persekutuan

2. (1) Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Lebuh Raya Pantai Timur–Fasa 2

yang bermula dari kilometer 250.620 di koordinat U+88993.651000, T+245032.711000

Grid Rectified Skew Orthomorphic (RSO) Geosentrik (GDM 2000) dan berakhir di

kilometer 433.977 di koordinat U+243442.227735, T+213048.376897 Grid RSO

Geosentrik (GDM 2000), termasuklah Persimpangan Bertingkat Cheneh, Persimpangan

Bertingkat Cukai, Persimpangan Bertingkat Kijal, Persimpangan Bertingkat Kertih,

Persimpangan Bertingkat Paka, Persimpangan Bertingkat Kuala Dungun, Persimpangan

Bertingkat Bukit Besi, Persimpangan Bertingkat Ajil, Persimpangan Bertingkat

Telemung, Persimpangan Bertingkat Kuala Terengganu dan jalan-jalan sambungannya,

iaitu suatu jarak sepanjang 183.357 kilometer diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan.

(2) Jalan yang diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan di bawah

subperenggan (1) ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual.

Pembatalan

3. Perintah Jalan Persekutuan (Lebuh Raya Pantai Timur–Fasa 2) 2014

[P.U. (A) 314/2014] dibatalkan.

JADUAL

[Subperenggan 2(2)]

PETA LEBUH RAYA PANTAI TIMUR–FASA 2

Dibuat 20 Januari 2015

[KKR.PUU. 110-1/7/3/2 (29); PN(PU2)391/XXIX]

DATO' SRI HAJI FADILLAH BIN HAJI YUSOF

Menteri Kerja Raya

[Akan dibentangkan di Dewan Rakyat menurut seksyen 4 Akta Jalan Persekutuan 1959]

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (EAST COAST EXPRESSWAY–PHASE 2) ORDER 2015

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Federal Roads Act 1959

[Act 376], the Minister, after consultation with the State Government of Terengganu,

makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (East Coast

Expressway–Phase 2) Order 2015.

 (2) This Order comes into operation on 29 January 2015.

Declaration of road to be Federal road

2. (1) The part of the road known as the East Coast Expressway–Phase 2

commencing from kilometre 250.620 at coordinates N+88993.651000,

E+245032.711000 Rectified Skew Orthomorphic (RSO) Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid

and ending at kilometre 433.977 at coordinates N+243442.227735, E+213048.376897

(RSO) Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid, including the Cheneh Interchange,

Cukai Interchange, Kijal Interchange, Kertih Interchange, Paka Interchange,

Kuala Dungun Interchange, Bukit Besi Interchange, Ajil Interchange, Telemung

Interchange, Kuala Terengganu Interchange and its link roads, being a distance of

183.357 kilometres is declared to be a Federal road.

(2) The road declared to be a Federal road under subparagraph (1) is shown

on the map in the Schedule.

Revocation

3. The Federal Roads (East Coast Expressway–Phase 2) Order 2014

[P.U. (A) 314/2014] is revoked.
